record.question: UN Secretary-General has recently appointed ambassador for UN Sustainable Development Goals from India namely:
record.explanation: Answer B: Dia Mirza. Dia Mirza was appointed a UN Sustainable Development Goals Advocate from India in 2019. Reference: https://www.un.org/sustainabledevelopment/blog/2019/09/meet-the-new-sdg-advocates/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
